verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so this is a tie. Both have the same flaws. The product can, the original's key image, has been reduced to a sliver or dropped, which leaves a text-only layout. The legal fine print sits between the headline and the body copy, which breaks the reading order and wrongly promotes it. The SUNSET SALE ribbon crowds the logo and headline in the top-left corner. The badges and CTA are jammed into a ragged cluster. The CTA is no bigger than the badges, so it doesn't stand out. A broken placeholder image is clipped at the right edge, and the margins are cramped all round.
